# dsh-tibo-reset-watch
A corner card inside DeepSeek Harness that shows what a watched X account just said — translated int
ard inside DeepSeek Harness that shows what a watched X account just said — translated into Chinese.
The card sits at the top-right edge as a small badge, pops open when a new post or reply arrives, an
d folds back to the badge once you have looked at every row. All fetching and translating happens on
the Host side: no agent turn is started, no conversation token is spent, and nothing happens while
the window is closed.
Ships with a **Tibo preset** (`@thsottiaux`): the Codex usage-limit rescues usually surface on his t
imeline first, so the preset tracks that timeline minute by minute. The same card can display any ot
her source you configure.
## Install

Restart DeepSeek Harness if the badge does not appear within a minute.
## What it does

- Polls every 3 minutes (configurable) and de-duplicates by post id.
- Shows the newest rows first;

hovering a row or clicking it marks it read.
- For replies, a `看原帖 ▾` button expands the post being

replied to, fetched through the keyless fxtwitter API.
- Adds a `◆ RESET` marker to rows whose text

mentions a usage-limit reset, quota or outage.
- Translates through the Host translation service whe
n one is installed. Without a translation service the card still works and simply shows the original
is installed. Without a translation service the card still works and simply shows the original text.
## Configuration
The first run writes `~/.dsh/tibo-reset-watch/config.json`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Field | Meaning |
| `accounts` | One or more sources to watch; every entry with `"enabled": true` is polled and merged

into the same card. |
| `sourceType` | `tiboreset` reads the markdown timeline page of a `tiboreset

` mirror; `json` reads a plain JSON endpoint. |
| `sourceUrl` | The URL to fetch. |
| `pollMinutes`

| Poll interval in minutes (minimum 1). |
| `keep` | How many rows to retain locally (minimum 5). |

| `translate` | Set to `false` to keep the original language only. |
| `cardTop` | Distance from the
top of the window in pixels, so the card can avoid other overlays. |
A `json` source must return one of these shapes:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`{ "items": [...] }`, `{ "data": [...] }` and a bare array are accepted as well. Recognised keys per
entry: `id`, `text` (or `content`), `createdAt` (or `created_at`, `date`), `replyTo`, `replyToId`,
`id`, `text` (or `content`), `createdAt` (or `created_at`, `date`), `replyTo`, `replyToId`, `stats`.
After editing the configuration, reload the window. No DeepSeek Harness restart is needed.
## Data source, limits and disclaimer
The built-in preset reads **tiboreset.com**, a third-party public text mirror of an X timeline. It i
s not an X API and not affiliated with X or OpenAI:

- the mirror lags the live timeline by a few minutes;
- it keeps roughly the last two days of posts,

so a long offline period loses the gap;
- it exposes text only — images, videos and reposts are not

shown;
- it can change or go away at any time; when it does, the card shows `OFFLINE` and the origi
nal rows stay readable.
Text and links belong to their authors. This plugin is a personal reader: it stores rows locally und
er `~/.dsh/tibo-reset-watch/` and sends nothing anywhere except the fetch of the source URL, the opt
ional quote lookup and the translation request.
## Privacy and data flow
Fetched and stored data stays on your machine, with one exception: the text that gets translated.
- The Host makes only these outbound requests: your configured `sourceUrl`, `api.fxtwitter.com/statu

s/<id>` when you expand a reply, and the Host translation service.
- Depending on how your DSH insta
llation routes translation, post text may reach a public provider (Google or Bing). Set `"translate"

: false` in the config to fully disable translation and keep every post local.
- Posts and read stat

e live in `~/.dsh/tibo-reset-watch/` and the browser's `localStorage`.
- The plugin never reads cred

entials, API keys, workspace files, session history or other application data.
- It runs with the pe
rmissions of any DSH plugin; reading `index.js` and `client.js` is enough to verify what it does.
## Files
| Path | Purpose |
| `index.js` | Host half: polling, parsing, translation, `/tibo-reset-watch/feed` route, state under

`~/.dsh/tibo-reset-watch/` |
| `client.js` | Client half: the card, the badge and read state in `lo

calStorage` |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch that inserts the plugin |
| `locale/*.json` | Plug
in title and description |
Editing `index.js` takes effect after restarting DeepSeek Harness; editing `client.js` takes effect
after a page reload.
